title: Backup & Restore Messages
summary: Back up and restore your WhatsApp chats and media safely on your device.
description:
Backup & Restore Messages is a fast and secure tool that helps you manage your WhatsApp data stored on your device. Easily back up your WhatsApp chats, restore your media, organize your folders, and keep your important conversations safe. Whether you’re switching phones or want to protect your chat history, this app gives you complete control over your local WhatsApp backups.

This app works only with local files on your device and is not affiliated with WhatsApp.

⭐ Key Features (SEO Optimized)

🔹 WhatsApp Chat Backup & Restore

Quickly back up your WhatsApp messages and restore them anytime. Manage your chat history and keep your conversations safe on your device.

🔹 Backup WhatsApp Media Files

Securely save WhatsApp photos, videos, audio messages, voice notes, statuses, and documents. Easily restore them whenever you need.

🔹 Local WhatsApp Backup Manager

Access and organize your WhatsApp folders, backup files, and media directories with a simple and clean interface.

🔹 Transfer & Move WhatsApp Data

Switching to a new phone? Copy or move your WhatsApp chat backups and media files between devices with ease.

🔹 Export & Save Chat History

Export selected chats or media into secure folders. Keep a personal archive of important WhatsApp conversations on your phone.

🔹 Simple, Fast & Reliable

The app is optimized for speed, easy navigation, and smooth file handling for all your WhatsApp backup needs.

🔐 Privacy & Security

* Your WhatsApp data stays 100% on your device
* We do not read, collect, or upload your messages
* No personal information is stored on our servers
* You stay in full control of your backups

📌 Why This App?

* Perfect for phone changes or upgrades
* Ideal for securing WhatsApp messages and media
* Great for organizing WhatsApp folders
* Helps prevent loss of important chats
* Easy solution for managing local WhatsApp backups

⚠️ Disclaimer

This app is not affiliated with WhatsApp, Meta, or any of their partners.
It works only with local backup files created and stored on your device.
